map.输入温度、湿度、风速和紫外线指数，加权计算旅游适宜度指数，给出出游建议。: Enter the temperature, humidity, wind speed and UV index to compute a weighted tourism suitability index and get travel advice.
map.📖 查看「旅游气象指数 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Tourism Meteorological Index User Guide"
map.旅游气象指数按温度(T)、湿度(RH)、风速(V)、紫外线(UV)四项舒适度加权: The tourism meteorological index weights four comfort items, temperature (T), humidity (RH), wind speed (V) and UV: temperature score = 100−|T−22|×3.5, humidity score = 100−|RH−55|×0.9, wind score = 100−|V−3|×6, UV score = 100−UV×9 (all clamped to 0-100); the composite idx = 0.35×temperature + 0.20×humidity + 0.20×wind + 0.25×UV, and the higher it is the better suited for travel (≥80 excellent, ≥65 suitable, ≥50 fair, ≥35 not very suitable, <35 unsuitable).
map.💡 旅游适宜度 = 0.35·温度分 + 0.20·湿度分 + 0.20·风速分: 💡 Tourism suitability = 0.35·temperature score + 0.20·humidity score + 0.20·wind score + 0.25·UV score; each sub-score is 100 at the comfort value and decreases with deviation, and the higher the composite score the better suited for travel.
map.温度舒适区取 18-26°C，湿度 40-65%，风速 1-5 m/s，紫外线: The temperature comfort zone is 18-26°C, humidity 40-65%, wind speed 1-5 m/s and UV 0-5
map.紫外线指数 0-2 低、3-5 中等、6-7 高、8-10 很高、11+ 极高: UV index 0-2 low, 3-5 moderate, 6-7 high, 8-10 very high, 11+ extreme
map.本指数为经验模型，实际体验因人而异: This index is an empirical model; actual experience varies from person to person
map.综合温、湿、风、日照算出游适宜指数。: Compute the travel suitability index from temperature, humidity, wind and sunshine.
map.给目的地「今天适合玩吗」建议。: Give a "is today good for visiting" recommendation for a destination.
map.景区错峰按指数排期。: Stagger visitor peaks at scenic spots by the index.
map.气温 22°C、RH 55%、风速 2 m/s、晴 → 旅游指数≈85（适宜），: Air temperature 22°C, RH 55%, wind speed 2 m/s, clear → tourism index ≈85 (suitable), comfortable and good for the outdoors.
map.气温 35°C、RH 80% 或大风 8 级 → 指数<40（不适宜），建议室内: Air temperature 35°C, RH 80% or force-8 gale → index <40 (unsuitable); advise staying indoors or rescheduling.
map.对温湿风光照按舒适度加权合成 0–100，越高越宜出游，阈值因地域（如高原）微调: Temperature, humidity, wind and sunshine are weighted by comfort into 0-100; the higher the more suitable for travel, with thresholds fine-tuned by region (e.g. highlands).
map.指数高能晒吗？: Does a high index mean sun exposure is fine?
map.适宜≠紫外线低，夏季仍要看 UV 指数另作防晒。: Suitable does not mean low UV; in summer you still need to check the UV index and take separate sun protection.
map.综合温度、湿度、风速和紫外线四项气象要素，以各要素相对舒适区的偏离程度计算分项得: Combining the four meteorological elements of temperature, humidity, wind speed and UV, it computes sub-scores from each element's deviation relative to the comfort zone and sums them with weights to get a 0-100 tourism meteorological suitability index, outputting travel advice and a UV protection notice.
